read_model: RunReadService/RunModeController read runtime lifecycle, immutable input and provider observations. TerminalSessionManager owns session leases; OperationalSurfaceManager composes views.
invariants: Request states require provider ACK before terminal lifecycle change
Retries use invocation digest and expected aggregate version
Provider loss is not Run completion
Preflight READY expires when input or provider epoch changes

epistemic.empty: No Run selected: show preflight/start affordance; no active runtime asserted.
epistemic.stale: Telemetry beyond freshness window remains historical last sample with lag; controls recheck lifecycle.
epistemic.unavailable: Terminal provider absent is explicit PLATFORM_GATED; no fake command execution.
epistemic.error: Start timeout queries idempotency receipt; never dispatch second start with new key.
